scope: Local method reproduction on RTX 4080 Super; not contest evaluator output

harness_at_capture.source_commit: 2ff9b81 plus uncommitted lab scripts (the manifest did not yet record dirty trees)
issues_found: No warm-up. Each freshly started server JIT-compiled Triton kernels (_zero_kv_blocks_kernel, _compute_slot_mapping_kernel, _causal_conv1d_fwd_kernel; batch_memcpy_kernel with prefix caching) while serving its first measured requests; vLLM logged 'Triton kernel JIT compilation during inference'. The first five arrivals of R0 took 897-1,082 ms TTFT against a ~17 ms median.

TPOT ended at the last content chunk, but server completion_tokens also counts the EOS token, whose finish chunk arrives one decode step later. For the 322-328 stop-terminated requests per stage the (N-1) denominator therefore spanned only N-2 intervals, biasing TPOT about 2% low (R0 mean 4.138 ms, about 4.208 ms corrected).
harness_at_capture.fixed_by: scripts/rtx4080_replay.py now serves 4 unrecorded two-turn warm-up conversations before the measured clock and ends TPOT at the finish chunk; scripts/rtx4080_compare.py flags mean gains that the median paired request does not share.

reanalysis_post_hoc.note: The 10-arrival cutoff was chosen after inspecting the data, so treat these numbers as a diagnosis, not a verdict. Medians need no cutoff and agree. Confirm with a clean warm-up rerun.

decision.reason: The apparent B gain and the apparent R0-to-R0-prime drift both came from cold-start JIT in the first five requests of R0. Without them the baseline did not drift, prefix caching made TTFT about 0.7 ms slower overall (slower on turns 1-4, faster on turns 5-6) and TPOT about 0.05 ms faster, for a net quoted-formula change near +0.2 ERS. Under the repo gate a TTFT CI entirely above zero is reject_slower, but the cutoff is post hoc.
decision.next: Rerun R0/B/R0-prime with the warm-up harness on an otherwise idle GPU before deciding.
